🔧 conveyor fix — evidence for the `review:changes` repair (fix-4624)

**Pushed head:** `459ea6f4f` (2 repair commits on top of `48f72cb3e`). **Verify: GREEN for exactly this sha** (attempt 2; attempt 1 was red on `exec-output-guard` + 2 check:standards `emit-then-exit` errors in `scripts/lib/red-main-quarantine-io.mjs`, fixed with `writeAllSync` + an explicit `maxBuffer`).

## Findings addressed
1. **CLI wiring untested (correctness F1, security F1, codex F2)** → new `scripts/__tests__/merge-ai-prs-red-main-hold-wiring.test.mjs` (not in the declared scope list: both reviewers named this file). It runs the REAL drain CLI **without** `--no-red-main-freeze`, VITEST cleared, hermetic gh/git shims, hold + mode + merge-queue settings pinned, and asserts the `gh pr merge` attempts.
2. **Freeze marker path move drops a live freeze (security/migration, codex F1)** → `migrateLegacyFreeze` / `retireLegacyFreeze` in `scripts/readiness/red-main-remediation.mjs`, called from the drain's `redMainFreezeStop` (skipped on `--dry-run`, any non-benign outcome logged). The new path stays the single authority.

## Before (red) — mutants of the wiring, tests run against them
Hold block neutralised (`v.decision='skip'` removed) + migration call disabled:
```
FAIL  manual freeze + published fix PR (hold ON by default): only the fix PR reaches gh pr merge; the other is a red-main-hold skip
FAIL  a published red alone (no manual freeze) also holds the unrelated PR while the fix PR lands
FAIL  red but NO fix PR published yet: nothing lands (no PR is exempt)
FAIL  the hold only ADDS: a fix PR that fails another merge gate (not mergeable) is not merged, and the other stays held
FAIL  rollout: a freeze that exists ONLY at the legacy per-clone path is carried to the coordination root and still holds
FAIL  rollout + setting OFF: the migrated legacy freeze still stops the whole line (exit 5)
Tests  6 failed | 3 passed (9)
```
Before this PR's repair, no test at all reddened for these mutations (every existing CLI test passed `--no-red-main-freeze`).

## After (green)
```
scripts/lib/__tests__/red-main-hold.test.mjs + scripts/__tests__/merge-ai-prs-red-main-hold-wiring.test.mjs
Test Files  2 passed (2)   Tests  37 passed (37)
```
CLI cases (all assert `gh pr merge` attempts): control (both land) · manual freeze + published fix PR (only the fix PR lands, other = `red-main-hold` skip) · published red alone · red with no fix PR (nothing lands) · fix PR failing another gate (not merged, other held) · setting OFF (exit 5, `stopped: red-main-freeze`) · setting OFF + published red (old behaviour, both land) · legacy-only marker (migrated, still holds) · legacy + new then `unfreeze` (both land) · legacy only then `unfreeze` (both land) · legacy + newer new-path marker (new wins, legacy set aside, held) · `--dry-run` (legacy not moved) · legacy + setting OFF (exit 5).
Real-surface probe: `node scripts/readiness/red-main-remediation.mjs status` → `{"frozen":false,"path":".../coordination/red-main-freeze.json","marker":null,"legacyMarkerPending":null}` (now read-only; reports a not-yet-migrated legacy marker).

## Self-review (adversarial subagent) — what it found and what I did
Fixed: stale old marker could resurface after `unfreeze`/`freeze` (new-path-wins branch now sets the old file aside; `freeze`/`unfreeze` retire it; `unfreeze` retires legacy BEFORE removing the new marker) · hard-link failure fallback (exclusive create) + per-pid temp names + no-clobber copy · non-benign migrate outcomes now logged, never silent · `status` and `--dry-run` no longer write · header doc updated · dangling test comment removed.
Residual, not fixed: a legacy marker sitting in the OTHER daemon clone is only found by passes running from that clone (the importing clone is the only one a pass can see; it is migrated, with its age logged, on that clone's first pass — fails safe: it holds, never lands) · old-code clones during rollout/rollback do not see the new path · doc mentions of the old location in `scripts/readiness/dispatch-pause.mjs`, `.gitignore` (outside this PR's scope).

## Variants considered
Defect class: **durable state silently ignored or duplicated after a storage-location change.**
- legacy marker only → fixed (migrated) · legacy + new → fixed (new wins, legacy set aside) · `unfreeze` before migration → fixed · `unfreeze` ordering window → fixed · `freeze` after legacy → fixed · hard-link unsupported → fixed (fallback) · concurrent migrators → fixed (no-clobber) · `--dry-run` / `status` writing → fixed · explicit `WE_RED_MAIN_FREEZE` → checked (never migrated) · corrupt legacy → checked (stays put, logged) · other-clone legacy marker → residual (above).

| row | status |
|---|---|
| untrusted text | n/a: marker fields are copied as before; `reason` is printed as before |
| truncated read | checked: a corrupt marker still fails open (unchanged, pre-existing design) |
| shared state | fixed at `red-main-remediation.mjs` migrate/retire/unfreeze (two writers: no-clobber link + per-pid tmp; stale lock: n/a; crash between write and rename: leaves a pid-named tmp, harmless) |
| rollback / switch | residual: old code does not see the new path; migrated file is set aside, not deleted |
| normalization | checked: `resolve()` compare of the two paths; same-path (test run) is a no-op |
| resource bounds | fixed: `maxBuffer` on the quarantine-io git read |
| trust boundary | checked: both paths are env/host-controlled, same as before |
